# Apache Tika Service

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docker.tika` |
| Source | `09_docker/tika.yaml` |

Apache Tika full server for content extraction and metadata detection across a
wide range of document formats. Stateless; no data volume required.
